scenarios.name: A's Home
scenarios.description: A modest single-story house where A lives. It has a small living room and a bedroom.

scenarios.name: Town Square
scenarios.description: The central town square with a fountain and some benches. A gathering point for the townsfolk.

scenarios.name: C's Company Building
scenarios.description: A two-story building. The first floor is C's office where A works. The second floor is C's private residence.

scenarios.name: B's Supermarket
scenarios.description: A small supermarket run by B. The front is the shop area, and the back has a small living quarters where B resides.

scenarios.name: Town Streets
scenarios.description: The roads and paths connecting the buildings in this small town.
